name: Marriott Bonvoy Boundless Credit Card

reward_currency.name: Marriott Bonvoy points
reward_currency.valuation_basis: TPG editorial valuation; not guaranteed cash value

base_reward.label: 2X Marriott Bonvoy points on other purchases

reward_rules.label: 3X on first $6,000 combined annual spend at grocery stores, gas stations, and dining

benefits.title: Airline offer: spend $250, earn $50
benefits.description: Earn a $50 statement credit after $250 in eligible purchases made directly with airlines in each offer window. Spending resets between windows; unused spending does not carry over. Record only the statement credit received, not the airline purchase amount.

qualifying_spend.description: Eligible purchases made directly with airlines; refunds and cancellations reduce qualifying spending.
qualifying_spend.posting_delay: Allow 6–8 weeks after qualifying for the statement credit to post.

period_schedules.label: Existing-cardmember 2026 offer
period_schedules.eligibility: Eligible existing cardmembers as of January 7, 2026; one-time enrollment required.

period_schedules.label: June 2026–June 2027 offer
period_schedules.eligibility: New cardmembers applying June 4–December 31, 2026. Use the offer shown on your Chase account; the annual-fee date does not determine eligibility.
period_schedules.enrollment: Automatically enrolled upon card activation for this new-cardmember offer.

valuation.basis: Issuer-stated $50 maximum after $250 qualifying airline spend in each selected offer window; $100 maximum across the two windows

benefits.title: 1 Free Night Award up to 35,000 points
benefits.description: 1 Free Night Award up to 35,000 points after each account anniversary

valuation.basis: Certificate-specific reasonable redemption estimate adjusted for restrictions; not a statistical average or guaranteed cash savings. Counts only after an actual stay.

certificate_policy.rule: One annual 35,000-point free-night award after the account anniversary. Expires 12 months from deposit; redeem for a stay with check-in on or before expiry. Additional top-up points and resort fees are not certificate value.

benefits.title: 50K bonus free-night awards
benefits.description: Record 50,000-point certificates actually issued by a qualifying promotion. These are separate from the annual 35K anniversary award; no welcome offer or quantity is assumed.

certificate_policy.rule: 50,000-point certificates are individual bonus awards, not annual 35K grants. Standard expiry is one year from issuance. Use the actual date in your Marriott account and check in on or before expiry; extra top-up points and resort fees do not add certificate value.

valuation.basis: Published certificate-specific reasonable redemption estimate for a 50K Marriott award; not a cash guarantee or statistical average. Counts only after an actual stay.
Elite-night credits are tracked but excluded from automatic card ROI
Hotel status is tracked but excluded from automatic card ROI

offer_ecosystem: Chase Offers (targeted merchant statement-credit offers; availability varies by account)
other_key_benefits: travel protections subject to guide to benefits
notes: The airline offer has two eligibility cohorts, not a permanently recurring $100 annual credit. Choose the offer schedule shown by Chase. Each window separately requires $250 spent directly with airlines to earn $50; the two cohorts are alternatives and must never be added together.

value.title: Temporary airline statement-credit promotion: up to $100 total
value.description: Temporary airline statement-credit promotion: up to $100 total through 2027, split into two $50 credits after qualifying airline spend

raw_source_fields.base_earn: 2X Marriott Bonvoy points on other purchases
raw_source_fields.bonus_categories: 6X at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels; 3X on first $6,000 combined annual spend at grocery stores, gas stations, and dining
raw_source_fields.recurring_credits: Temporary airline statement-credit promotion: up to $100 total through 2027, split into two $50 credits after qualifying airline spend; see terms
raw_source_fields.annual_or_anniversary_benefits: 1 Free Night Award up to 35,000 points after each account anniversary; 15 Elite Night Credits annually; automatic Silver Elite
raw_source_fields.spend_threshold_benefits: 1 Elite Night Credit per $5,000 spend; Gold Elite after $35,000 calendar-year spend
